messages:
auditor_claire: Hi all, auditor checking in. We need SOC2+ISO evidence for access to the private inference enclave (VPC + KMS keys) across the last 12 months: RBAC changes, KMS Decrypt/GenerateDataKey usage, key rotation proof, and any incident linkage. What artifacts and ETA?

nova(sec): We can provide: (1) RBAC change CSV from k8s + IAM snapshots, (2) KMS CloudTrail exports for Decrypt/GenerateDataKey, (3) key rotation manifests and DescribeKey snapshots, (4) incident correlation table linking role changes to IR tickets.

marta(devops): Quick Q: full 12 months raw logs or sampled bundles? Sampling ok if we provide precise criteria plus full windows around incidents.

auditor_claire: Full 12 months preferred. If sampling is necessary, we'll accept exact sampling method and every full window tied to an incident.

tyler(dev): For k8s RBAC I can run this query in cluster-log-index:
```
source=k8s_audit "RoleBinding" OR "ClusterRoleBinding" | table user, verb, objectRef.name, @timestamp
```
I'll produce CSV with before/after state where available.

ops_ana: For AWS KMS: CloudTrail -> S3 -> Athena. Example Athena filter for Decrypts:
```sql
SELECT eventTime, userIdentity.arn, eventName, requestParameters.keyId FROM cloudtrail WHERE eventName IN ('Decrypt','GenerateDataKey') AND eventTime BETWEEN '2025-03-01' AND '2026-03-01'
```
We'll export compressed CSVs.

nova(sec): Include STS AssumeRole joins so auditors can see temporary creds leading to KMS ops. I'll prepare a mapping script and short README.

marta(devops): Redaction note: redact customer identifiers and PII; preserve internal principal ids (employee/service) and timestamps. Include a redaction log.

tyler(dev): Incident example: IR-2025-109 had a role change + a Decrypt 2h later flagged by anomaly detector. I'll include timeline snippet and sanitized logs.

ops_ana: ETA: full exports + redaction + manifest = 6 business days. Sample + mapping only = 2 days.

auditor_claire: 6 days acceptable. Also need control mapping doc linking artifacts to SOC2 CC6 and ISO 27001 A.9, with detection narrative.

nova(sec): I'll own control mapping and detection narrative. Marta/tyler please own exports. Ana will provide S3 pre-signed secure share and signed manifest with SHA256 checksums.

marta(devops): Agreed. I'll start RBAC + KMS exports tomorrow.

evidence_bot: export-queue: job=exp-3412 owner=marta ETA=24h (automated).

ops_ana: I'll provision pre-signed S3 share (14d expiry) and include S3 object versions.

tyler(dev): Deliverables list: RBAC_changes.csv, KMS_cloudtrail.csv, key_rotation_manifest.csv, incident_correlation.csv, redaction_log.txt, control_mapping.pdf, export_manifest.json (signed).

auditor_claire: Please ensure export_manifest lists exporter, timestamp, SHA256 for each file and a checksum for the whole bundle. Also attach attestation (who exported).

nova(sec): Will include detection playbook snippets showing how we detect unauthorized bindings and anomalous KMS usage.

marta(devops): Pinged when first CSV ready.

auditor_claire: Thanks — please @me when the secure share is posted.
